paper_title: Constraints on Light Dark Matter Particles Interacting with Electrons from DAMIC at SNOLAB
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter kappa (chi), dimensionless, as plotted
notes: Paper presents 90% C.L. limits on hidden-photon (dark photon) DM kinetic mixing kappa vs mass mV over 1.2-30 eV (Fig. 4), and DM-electron scattering cross section (Fig. 2). Coupling type is clearly DarkPhoton (kinetic mixing kappa/epsilon). However, no numerical limit values are given in the text or any table - the kappa vs mV limits only appear in Fig. 4, so no data points could be reliably extracted. Local DM density rho=0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Traced the DAMIC-at-SNOLAB solid blue curve in Fig. 4 (kinetic mixing kappa vs m_V in eV). The provided axis calibration (0.5-100 MeV, 1e-36..1e-27) corresponds to Fig. 3 (DM-electron cross section, not DarkPhoton) and was NOT used; per the hint (DarkPhoton, chi vs mass in eV) I used Fig. 4 axes. Mass axis is in eV directly. Excluded region is above the curve. The curve has a broad minimum near m_V~20 eV (kappa~7e-15) then rises. Text states best hidden-photon constraints in mass range 1.2-9 eV. | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=0.37 snapped to identity)
